title: App status
offlineCheckHelp: Reconnect to the internet to check for updates.
checkFailedHelp: The published version could not be checked. Try again.
offlineUnavailableHelp: This browser cannot save the course for offline use. You can still use it online.
offlineCheckFailed: Could not check the offline copy. Retry to check whether all course files are available.
offlineHelp: Saves every chapter and the files needed to run its code in this browser. Stay connected until the download finishes.
restartHelp: Only this tab restarts, including Python if it is running. Saved answers and code are kept. Other tabs stay open and offer a restart separately.
busy: Wait for the running code to finish before restarting.
unsaved: Some changes are not saved. Use Export answers and Download code before trying to restart.
composing: Finish entering your text before restarting.
otherTabBusy: Another tab is updating the course. Wait for it to finish, then retry.
updateFailed: Could not prepare the update. Check your connection and available storage, then retry. Any complete offline copy is kept.
downloadFailed: Could not complete the download. Check your connection and available storage, then retry. Any complete offline copy is kept.
restartFailed: Could not restart with the update. This tab has not reloaded. Try again.
cancelled: Download cancelled. You can resume it later. Any complete offline copy is kept.
removeConfirm: Remove the downloaded course files? Your answers, notes, code edits and imported or generated files will be kept.
removed: Offline copy removed. Your answers, notes, code edits and imported or generated files are kept.
removeFailed: Could not remove the offline copy. Try again.
storageNote: Your browser may clear stored site data. Keep separate copies of your work with Export answers and Download code.
